text: 北证50指数半日涨超4%，机器人概念股集体爆发。 恒指半日跌0.95%，恒生科技指数跌1.21%，联想集团跌超7%。 连续第17个月维持不变！10月LPR报价出炉：5年期以上3.5%，1年期3%。 中国央行将在10月21日至11月2日开展隔夜逆回购操作，每日操作量不超过10000亿元。 中国央行：境外央行类机构回购工具的操作对象纳入外资人民币业务清算行。 国家发改委：正在研究制定扩大内需战略实施方案。 证监会法制司司长程合红：研究推进将《证券法》修改纳入下一届全国人大的立法规划。 日本20年期国债拍卖认购倍数创历史新高。 报道：OpenAI计划在Anth
text_en: The BSE 50 Index rose more than 4% in the half-day session, with robot concept stocks surging across the board. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.95% in the half-day session, the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.21%, and Lenovo Group dropped more than 7%. Unchanged for the 17th consecutive month! The October LPR fixing is out: the 5-year and above rate at 3.5%, and the 1-year rate at 3%. The PBOC will conduct overnight reverse repo operations from October 21 to November 2, with daily operation volumes not exceeding 1 trillion yuan. PBOC: Foreign central bank-type institutions' repo tool counterparties will include foreign-funded RMB business clearing banks. National Development and Reform Commission: An implementation plan for the strategy of expanding domestic demand is being studied and formulated. CSRC Director-General of the Legal Affairs Department Cheng Hehong: Studies are underway to include the revision of the Securities Law in the legislative plan of the next National People's Congress.
